name: laravel/laravel
description: The skeleton application for the Laravel framework.

dev: npx concurrently -c "#93c5fd,#c4b5fd,#fb7185,#fdba74" "php artisan serve" "php artisan queue:listen --tries=1" "php artisan pail --timeout=0" "npm run dev" --names=server,queue,logs,vite

ignore.PKSA-m5cs-t1y6-qpcs: Laravel 11 signed-URL path confusion. Not backported to 11.x (framework is EOL; fixed only in 12.61.1+/13.12+). This app has exactly one signed route (email verification), which limits the practical exploit surface. Tracked: plan to upgrade to Laravel 12/13.
ignore.PKSA-3r5d-mb8f-1qw9: Laravel 11 CRLF injection in the default `email` validation rule. Not backported to 11.x (EOL; fixed only in 12.60+/13.10+). This app never builds raw mail headers from user input — all outgoing mail goes through Laravel's Mail facade (Symfony Mailer), which encodes headers regardless of validation. Tracked: plan to upgrade to Laravel 12/13.
